caption: The video captures a person in a brown hooded top and orange life vest seated inside a low raft woven from dark tubes, floating in churning green whitewater below a concrete spillway lined with blue pontoons. A paddle with a yellow blade and blue shaft stands upright beside the rider, then gradually tilts rightward. The rider's head and torso recline and sink lower behind the tube pile, partly hidden by splashing water as whitewater washes over the raft. The paddle blade lowers toward horizontal and dips toward the surface, while the looped tubes on the right remain the most visible part of the frame. The camera framing shifts slightly while keeping the bobbing craft mostly central.
